environment.description: The name of the environment for the alert to evaluate in

workflow_id.description: The ID of the alert you'd like to query.

action_filters.description: The filters to run before the action will fire and the action(s) to fire. logicType can be one of: any-short, all, or none. See API documentation for full schema of conditions and actions.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.

update_an_existing_custom_integration.title: Update an existing custom integration
update_an_existing_custom_integration.description: Updates an existing custom integration (Sentry App) with new configuration. Use this action to modify integration settings such as name, scopes, webhook URL, or other configuration. You must provide the integration's slug or ID and the required fields (name and scopes).

name.description: The name of the custom integration. This is the display name shown to users.

author.description: The custom integration's author name or organization.

events.description: Webhook events the custom integration is subscribed to (e.g., 'issue', 'comment', 'event.alert').

schema.description: The UI components schema, used to render the custom integration's configuration UI elements. See Sentry's schema docs for more information.

scopes.description: The custom integration's permission scopes for API access (e.g., 'project:read', 'event:read', 'org:read'). This field is required for updating the integration.

overview.description: The custom integration's description or overview text.

isInternal.description: Whether or not the integration is internal only. False means the integration is public. Defaults to false if not specified.

webhookUrl.description: The webhook destination URL where Sentry will send event notifications.

isAlertable.description: Marks whether or not the custom integration can be used in an alert rule. Defaults to false if not specified.

redirectUrl.description: The post-installation redirect URL where users are sent after installing the integration.

verifyInstall.description: Whether or not an installation of the custom integration should be verified. Defaults to true if not specified.

allowedOrigins.description: The list of allowed origins for CORS configuration.

sentry_app_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the custom integration to update. Use the slug (e.g., 'my-integration'), not the UUID. Slugs are case-sensitive.

update_a_projects_symbol_source.title: Update a symbol source in a project
update_a_projects_symbol_source.description: Updates an existing custom symbol source (HTTP, GCS, or S3) in a project for fetching debug symbols. Use when you need to modify the configuration of a symbol source identified by its ID.

id.description: The ID of the symbol source to update. This is passed as a query parameter.

url.description: Base URL for an HTTP symbol source. Required if type is 'http'.

name.description: Human-readable name for the symbol source.

bucket.description: Name of the GCS or S3 bucket containing symbols. Required if type is 'gcs' or 's3'.

prefix.description: Optional path prefix within the GCS or S3 bucket.

password.description: Password for HTTP basic authentication. Optional for HTTP sources.

username.description: Username for HTTP basic authentication. Optional for HTTP sources.

source_id.description: Optional internal ID of the source. Must be distinct from all other source IDs and cannot start with 'sentry:'.

access_key.description: AWS Access Key ID for S3 authentication. Required if type is 's3'.

secret_key.description: AWS Secret Access Key for S3 authentication. Required if type is 's3'.

private_key.description: Private key (PEM format) for GCS service account. Required if type is 'gcs'.

client_email.description: Client email for GCS service account. Required if type is 'gcs'.

filters__filetypes.description: List of file types to filter. Optional filtering configuration.

project_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the project containing the symbol source.

filters__path_patterns.description: List of glob patterns for path matching. Optional filtering configuration.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization that owns the project.

filters__requires_checksum.description: Whether debug checksums are mandatory. Defaults to false if not specified.

update_environment_visibility.title: Update environment visibility
update_environment_visibility.description: Updates the visibility of a specific environment within a Sentry project.

isHidden.description: Indicates if the environment should be hidden (`true`) or visible (`false`).

environment.description: The name of the environment to update.

project_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the Sentry project.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the Sentry organization.

update_external_team_integration.title: Update external team integration
update_external_team_integration.description: Updates an existing external team integration's display name, provider, Sentry integration ID, or external ID; the `integration_id` must match a valid, configured Sentry integration for the organization and the specified `provider`.

external_id.description: Optional: External ID for the team within the provider's system, distinct from its name.

external_name.description: New display name for the team in the external provider.

integration_id.description: Unique ID of the Sentry integration instance connecting Sentry to the external provider.

team_id_or_slug.description: ID or slug of the Sentry team.

external_team_id.description: Unique ID of the external team object to update.

organization_id_or_slug.description: ID or slug of the Sentry organization.

update_external_user_for_organization.title: Update external user for organization
update_external_user_for_organization.description: Updates attributes of an existing external user linkage (identified by `external_user_id`) within a Sentry organization (specified by `organization_id_or_slug`).

id.description: The unique Sentry identifier of the external user record being updated. This typically matches the `external_user_id` path parameter.

user_id.description: The Sentry user ID to be linked or that is currently linked with this external user.

external_id.description: The user's unique identifier on the external provider's platform (e.g., 'U123ABC' for Slack, 'github_user_123' for GitHub). This is optional.

external_name.description: The user's display name or username on the external provider platform (e.g., 'john.doe' or 'John Doe').

integration_id.description: The Sentry ID of the integration instance (e.g., a specific Slack workspace or GitHub organization integration) through which this external user is known.

external_user_id.description: The unique identifier of the external user record within Sentry to update.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (numeric ID or string slug) of the Sentry organization to which the external user is linked.

update_issue_attributes_in_organization.title: Update issue attributes in organization
update_issue_attributes_in_organization.description: Updates specified attributes of an existing Sentry issue within a Sentry organization, leaving other attributes unchanged.

status.description: The new status to assign to the issue. Valid values: "resolved", "resolvedInNextRelease", "unresolved", "ignored".

hasSeen.description: Updates if the user has seen the issue (true for seen, false for unseen).

isPublic.description: Sets the issue's visibility (true for public, false for private).

issue_id.description: The unique identifier of the issue to be updated.

assignedTo.description: Actor ID (e.g., 'user:1', 'team:2'), username, or email for assignment. Omit, or use an empty string or 'null' equivalent, to unassign.

isBookmarked.description: Updates the user's bookmark for the issue (true to bookmark, false to remove).

isSubscribed.description: Updates the user's notification subscription for the issue (true to subscribe, false to unsubscribe).

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or slug of the Sentry organization.

statusDetails__inCommit.description: The commit hash associated with the fix for this issue.

statusDetails__inRelease.description: The Sentry release version in which the issue is considered resolved.

statusDetails__inNextRelease.description: Specifies if the issue is resolved in the next Sentry release.

update_monitor_for_project.title: Update monitor for project
update_monitor_for_project.description: Updates a monitor for a project. Use when you need to modify monitor name, schedule, check-in margin, max runtime, timezone, status, owner, or alert thresholds for a project-level monitor.

name.description: Name of the monitor. Used for notifications. Required field.

slug.description: Uniquely identifies your monitor within your organization. Changing this slug will require updates to any instrumented check-in calls. Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.

owner.description: The ID of the team or user that owns the monitor. Format: 'user:51' or 'team:6'.

config.description: The configuration for the monitor including schedule, thresholds, and alert settings.

project.description: The project slug to associate the monitor to. Required field.

is_muted.description: Disable creation of monitor incidents. Set to true to suppress alerts.

monitor_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the monitor to update.

project_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the project the resource belongs to.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.

update_organization_alert_rules.title: Update organization alert rules
update_organization_alert_rules.description: Replaces an existing Sentry metric alert rule's configuration; fields not provided in the request are removed or reset. This action updates an existing metric alert rule. Note that this is a full replacement - any fields not provided will be removed or reset to defaults. Prerequisites: - The organization must have metric alerts feature enabled - The alert_rule_id must be a valid existing metric alert rule - Use SENTRY_FETCH_ORGANIZATION_ALERT_RULES to get existing alert rule IDs

name.description: Descriptive name for the alert rule.

owner.description: Sentry actor ID (e.g., `team:123`, `user:456`) owning the rule, determining management permissions.

query.description: Sentry search query to filter events/metrics. An empty string (`''`) applies no filter.

dataset.description: Dataset to query (`events`, `transactions`, `metrics`, `sessions`, `generic-metrics`). Affects available fields/aggregations; see Sentry's 'Metric Alert Rule Types' docs.

projects.description: List of project slugs to scope the alert rule.

triggers.description: List of trigger configurations defining alert conditions (critical/warning labels, thresholds) and notification actions (e.g., email, Slack). `critical` label is mandatory. See Sentry API docs for full action schema.

aggregate.description: Aggregate function for the metric (e.g., `count`, `p95`). See Sentry's 'Metric Alert Rule Types' documentation for configurations based on dataset and query type.

queryType.description: Query type, often related to `dataset`: `0` (error events), `1` (transaction events), `2` (none). See Sentry's 'Metric Alert Rule Types' for valid combinations.

eventTypes.description: Specific event types for this alert (e.g., `default`, `error`, `transaction`).

timeWindow.description: Time window in minutes for `aggregate` computation (1, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 120, 240, 1440).

environment.description: Environment to filter events/metrics (e.g., 'production'). If omitted, applies to all environments.

monitorType.description: Monitoring state of the rule (e.g., continuously active or conditionally activated via `activationCondition`).

alert_rule_id.description: Unique numeric ID of the metric alert rule to update.

thresholdType.description: Comparison operator for thresholds: `0` for 'Above' (metric > threshold) or 'Higher than' (percentage change), `1` for 'Below' (metric < threshold) or 'Lower than'.

comparisonDelta.description: Comparison period (minutes) for percentage change thresholds (e.g., 'X% higher than Y minutes ago'). Required if `thresholdType` implies percentage change; not for 'Crash Free...' alerts.

resolveThreshold.description: Metric value for alert resolution. If unspecified, derived from lowest severity trigger. If `thresholdType` is `0` ('Above'), `resolveThreshold` must be < critical threshold to resolve when metric drops below this value; if `1` ('Below'), it must be > critical threshold to resolve when metric rises above this value.

activationCondition.description: Optional condition for rule activation, used with certain `monitorType` values.

organization_id_or_slug.description: Unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization.

update_organization_dashboard.title: Update organization dashboard
update_organization_dashboard.description: Updates an existing custom dashboard, allowing modifications to its title, widgets, and data filters; providing `widgets`, `projects`, `environment`, `period`, `start`, `end`, or `filters` will overwrite existing settings for those fields.

id.description: Unique identifier for the dashboard; should match existing ID if updating.

end.description: The absolute end time for the dashboard's time range, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-02T00:00:00Z'). If provided along with 'start', `period` is ignored. Replaces the existing end time.

utc.description: A boolean indicating whether the dashboard's time range should be displayed in UTC. `True` for UTC, `False` for the user's local time.

start.description: The absolute start time for the dashboard's time range, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z'). If provided along with 'end', `period` is ignored. Replaces the existing start time.

title.description: The new title for the dashboard.

period.description: The relative time range period for the dashboard (e.g., '24h', '7d', '30d'). Replaces the existing period. If 'start' and 'end' are set, this is ignored.

filters.description: A dictionary of additional filters to apply to the dashboard data, replacing existing filters. Keys are filter names, values are filter values.

widgets.description: A list of widget configurations to be updated or set for this dashboard. This will replace all existing widgets.

projects.description: A list of project IDs to filter the dashboard data by. Replaces the existing project filter.

environment.description: A list of environment names to filter the dashboard data by. Replaces the existing environment filter.

dashboard_id.description: The ID of the dashboard to be updated.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.

update_organization_member_role.title: Update organization member role
update_organization_member_role.description: Updates a Sentry organization member's organization-level role (`orgRole`) and/or their team roles (`teamRoles`), ensuring the initiator has permissions equivalent to both the member's current and intended new `orgRole` if `orgRole` is being modified.

member_id.description: The ID of the member whose roles are to be updated.

teamRoles.description: List of team role assignments (each object specifying `teamSlug` and `role`). This list completely replaces existing team roles. An empty list (default) removes the member from all teams. Team roles: `contributor` (views/acts on issues), `admin` (full team/project management).

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization to which the member belongs.

update_project_details.title: Update project details
update_project_details.description: Updates a Sentry project's settings (e.g., name, slug, platform, bookmark status); `isBookmarked` can be updated with `project:read` permission, other fields typically require `project:write` or `project:admin` permissions.

name.description: The new name for the project.

slug.description: The new unique identifier (slug) for the project, used in URLs and the Sentry interface.

platform.description: The new platform for the project (e.g., `python`, `javascript`, `java`). This helps Sentry categorize and process errors.

resolveAge.description: The duration in hours after which an issue is automatically resolved if it hasn't been seen. Set to `0` to disable auto-resolution.

isBookmarked.description: Toggles whether the project is starred (bookmarked) in the Sentry UI.

highlightTags.description: A list of tag keys (e.g., 'release', 'environment') to highlight on this project's issues in Sentry's UI. For example: `["release", "environment", "server_name"]`.

subjectPrefix.description: Custom prefix for the subject line of notification emails sent from this project.

subjectTemplate.description: The template for the email subject (excluding the prefix) for individual issue alerts. Available variables: `$title`, `$shortID`, `$projectID`, `$orgID`, and `${tag:key}` (e.g., `${tag:environment}`, `${tag:release}`).

highlightContext.description: A JSON object mapping context types (e.g., 'user', 'device') to a list of their keys to be highlighted in Sentry's UI for issues within this project. For example: `{"user": ["id", "email"], "device": ["model"]}`.

project_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the Sentry project to be updated.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the Sentry organization to which the project belongs.

update_project_issue_status_and_details.title: Update project issue status and details
update_project_issue_status_and_details.description: Bulk update attributes of issues in a Sentry project, targeting issues by a list of IDs or by a query status (which implies updating all matching issues if IDs are omitted).

id.description: Issue IDs to update. Accepts a list of integers for bulk updates. Optional; if omitted and the 'status' query parameter (filter) is used, updates all issues matching that status.

merge.description: Set to true to merge issues, false to unmerge. If merging, ensure the target issue ID is correctly specified.

status.description: The new status to apply to the selected issues (request body parameter). Valid values are `"resolved"`, `"resolvedInNextRelease"`, `"unresolved"`, and `"ignored"`.

hasSeen.description: If called with user context: true to mark issue as seen by the user, false as unseen.

isPublic.description: Set to true for public, false for private.

assignedTo.description: Actor ID (e.g., `user:123` or `team:456`) or username for assignment. Use an empty string or null to unassign.

isBookmarked.description: If called with user context: true to bookmark issue for the user, false to remove bookmark.

ignoreDuration.description: Minutes to ignore this issue (alternative to `statusDetails.ignoreDuration`).

project_id_or_slug.description: ID or slug of the Sentry project.

organization_id_or_slug.description: ID or slug of the Sentry organization.

statusDetails__inCommit.description: Commit ID in which the issue is resolved.

statusDetails__inRelease.description: Version/release in which the issue is resolved.

statusDetails__ignoreCount.description: Number of times to ignore the issue before it resurfaces.

statusDetails__inNextRelease.description: Indicates if the issue is resolved in the next release.

statusDetails__ignoreDuration.description: Duration (in minutes) to ignore the issue.

statusDetails__ignoreUserCount.description: Number of unique users affected before a previously ignored issue resurfaces.

update_project_key_configuration.title: Update project key configuration
update_project_key_configuration.description: Updates configuration settings (e.g., name, status, rate limits, SDK options) for an existing Sentry client key (DSN), identified by `key_id`, within a specified `project_id_or_slug` and `organization_id_or_slug`.

name.description: New human-readable name for the client key. Name will not be changed if omitted.

key_id.description: The ID of the client key (DSN public key) to be updated.

isActive.description: Specifies if the client key should be active (`true` to activate, `false` to deactivate). Status remains unchanged if omitted.

rateLimit__count.description: Maximum number of events the key can accept within `rateLimit_window`. Uses existing settings or project defaults if omitted.

rateLimit__window.description: Time window in seconds for `rateLimit_count` (e.g., 3600 for 1 hour). Uses existing settings or project defaults if omitted.

project_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry project whose key is being updated.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization to which the project belongs.

dynamicSdkLoaderOptions__hasDebug.description: Enable (`true`) or disable (`false`) Debugging features for the dynamic SDK loader. Current setting remains unchanged if omitted.

dynamicSdkLoaderOptions__hasReplay.description: Enable (`true`) or disable (`false`) Session Replay for the dynamic SDK loader. Current setting remains unchanged if omitted.

dynamicSdkLoaderOptions__hasPerformance.description: Enable (`true`) or disable (`false`) Performance Monitoring for the dynamic SDK loader. Current setting remains unchanged if omitted.

update_project_ownership_settings.title: Update project ownership settings
update_project_ownership_settings.description: Updates the ownership configuration settings (raw rules, fallthrough, auto-assignment, CODEOWNERS sync) for a Sentry project; omitted attributes retain their current values.

raw.description: Raw Sentry ownership rule string (e.g., 'path:src/components/* #frontend') defining issue assignment based on file paths or URLs. See Sentry's Ownership Rules documentation for syntax.

fallthrough.description: If `True`, assigns issues to all project members if no ownership rule matches; if `False`, no owners are set by default in such cases.

autoAssignment.description: Strategy for assigning new issues not covered by ownership rules. Options: 'Auto Assign to Issue Owner', 'Auto Assign to Suspect Commits', 'Turn off Auto-Assignment'.

codeownersAutoSync.description: If `True` (default), automatically synchronizes Sentry issue ownership with the repository's CODEOWNERS file during a release.

project_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the Sentry project.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the Sentry organization.

update_project_release_file_details.title: Update project release file details
update_project_release_file_details.description: Updates the name (path) or distribution identifier of a specific file within an existing project release in Sentry.

dist.description: The new distribution identifier for the file. Used to distinguish different builds of the same release version (e.g., build numbers or commit SHAs). WARNING: The Sentry API may not reliably update this field via the PUT endpoint; the 'name' parameter updates successfully but 'dist' may remain unchanged. At least one of 'name' or 'dist' must be provided.

name.description: The new name or full path for the file. Use absolute paths (e.g., '~/dist/main.js') or URLs (e.g., 'https://example.com/app.js'). At least one of 'name' or 'dist' must be provided.

file_id.description: The unique identifier of the release file to be updated.

version.description: The version identifier of the release, e.g., '1.0.0' or 'my-app@2.3.1'.

project_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the project associated with the release file.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization to which the project belongs.

update_project_rule_by_id.title: Update Project Rule By Id
update_project_rule_by_id.description: Updates an existing Sentry project issue alert rule by `rule_id`, completely overwriting it; all rule fields must be provided in the request, as omitted fields may be cleared or reset to defaults.

name.description: The new name for the alert rule.

owner.description: The ID of the team or user that owns this rule. Format: `team:TEAM_ID` or `user:USER_ID` or the user's email, or a team name prefixed with '#'. For example, 'user@example.com' or '#platform-team'.

actions.description: Actions performed when rule conditions and filters are met. Structure varies by action type chosen; refer to Sentry's issue alert rule documentation.

filters.description: Optional filters refining when the rule fires after conditions are met. Structure varies by filter type chosen; refer to Sentry's issue alert rule documentation.

rule_id.description: The numeric ID of the alert rule to be updated.

frequency.description: The minimum interval, in minutes, between actions for the same issue. Valid range is `5` to `43200` (30 days).

conditions.description: Conditions that trigger the rule. Structure varies by condition type chosen; refer to Sentry's issue alert rule documentation.

environment.description: Specific environment for this rule (e.g., 'production'); applies to all environments if omitted.

project_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry project.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization.

update_release_details_for_organization.title: Update release details for organization
update_release_details_for_organization.description: Updates an existing Sentry release's details for an organization, including its reference, URL, release date, associated commits, or repository references.

ref.description: Commit reference (e.g., a branch name, tag, or commit SHA) to associate with this release; useful if a tagged version has been provided.

url.description: A URL that points to the release. For instance, this can be the path to an online interface to the source code, such as a GitHub URL, or a link to a release announcement.

refs.description: Indicates or updates the start and end commits for each repository in a release. Head commits require ``repository`` and ``commit`` (HEAD SHA), and can optionally include ``previousCommit`` (SHA of previous release's HEAD) for initial data sends or corrections.

commits.description: List of commit data to associate or update for this release; can add new commits or modify existing ones if Sentry's commit tracking needs adjustment.

version.description: The version identifier of the release to be updated (e.g., '1.0.0', 'my-project@2.3.12'). This identifier must be unique within the organization.

dateReleased.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the release went live (e.g., '2023-10-26T10:00:00Z'). If not provided, Sentry uses the current time, but an existing dateReleased will not be overwritten unless a new value is provided.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique ID or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization.

update_saved_query_for_organization.title: Update a saved query for an organization
update_saved_query_for_organization.description: Updates an existing Discover saved query for a Sentry organization.

end.description: The specific end date and time for the query's time range, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-31T23:59:59Z'); used if 'range' is not provided.

name.description: The new user-defined name for the saved query.

query.description: The Sentry search query string to filter results (e.g., 'error.type:ZeroDivisionError browser.name:Firefox'). Refer to Sentry's search syntax documentation for details.

range.description: The relative time range period for this saved query (e.g., '24h', '7d', '30d'); an alternative to specific 'start' and 'end' times.

start.description: The specific start date and time for the query's time range, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z'); used if 'range' is not provided.

yAxis.description: A list of aggregate functions to be plotted on the Y-axis of the chart (e.g., 'count()', 'p95(transaction.duration)').

fields.description: A list of fields, functions, or equations for the query, with a maximum of 20. Each item can be: 1. A built-in key field (e.g., 'transaction'; see Sentry's properties table for event properties). 2. A tag, formatted as 'tag[tagName]' (e.g., 'tag[isEnterprise]'). 3. A function, like 'function_name(parameters,...)' (e.g., 'count_if(transaction.duration,greater,300)'; Discover groups by tags/fields w

display.description: The visualization type for the saved query chart. Allowed values are: 'default', 'previous', 'top5', 'daily', 'dailytop5', 'bar'.

orderby.description: Field to sort the query results by. Must be one of the items in the 'fields' list (excluding equations). Prefix with a hyphen '-' for descending order (e.g., '-count()').

interval.description: The resolution of the time series for the chart (e.g., '1h', '1d', '30m').

projects.description: A list of project IDs to associate with this saved query. An empty list means the query applies to all projects selected in the Sentry UI unless overridden.

query_id.description: The unique identifier of the Discover saved query to be updated.

topEvents.description: The number of top events' timeseries to be visualized on the chart.

environment.description: A list of environment names to filter the query by.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the Sentry organization to which the saved query belongs.

update_team_information_by_organization_.title: Update team information by organization id
update_team_information_by_organization_.description: Updates the slug for an existing team within a Sentry organization.

slug.description: The new slug for the team. Must be unique within the organization and follow the pattern: starts with a lowercase letter, followed by lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.

team_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the team whose slug is to be updated.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the organization to which the team belongs.

update_user_email.title: Update user email
update_user_email.description: Updates the primary email address for a Sentry user. The new email must already be added as a secondary email and be verified. **AUTHENTICATION REQUIREMENTS:** - Requires `user:write` scope - Typically requires a PERSONAL auth token (created from User Settings > Personal Tokens) - Internal integration tokens (organization-scoped) may not have permission for user-level operations **PREREQUISITES:** - The new email must already be added to the user's account as a secondary email - The email must be verified before it can be set as primary **COMMON ERRORS:** - 403 Forbidden: Token lacks user:write scope or is not a personal auth token - 400 Bad Request: Email is not already added to the account or is not verified

email.description: The new primary email address to set for the user. This email must already be added as a secondary email to the user's account and be verified before it can be set as primary. The email must be in valid format (e.g., user@example.com).

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the Sentry user whose primary email address is to be updated. Can be the numerical user ID or 'me' for the authenticated user. NOTE: This endpoint requires user:write scope and typically requires a personal auth token (from User Settings > Personal Tokens) rather than an integration token.

update_webhook_configuration_xp.title: Update webhook configuration
update_webhook_configuration_xp.description: Updates an existing Sentry service hook's target URL and subscribed event types for a given project and organization. Service hooks (webhooks) are HTTP callbacks that notify external systems when specific events occur in Sentry. This action allows you to modify the webhook's URL and change which events trigger notifications. Valid event types are: - 'event.alert': Triggered when alerts fire - 'event.created': Triggered when new events are processed Requirements: - Authentication with 'project:write' scope - The 'servicehooks' feature must be enabled for your Sentry plan - The hook_id must be a valid GUID from an existing service hook Common use cases: - Updating webhook URL when your endpoint changes - Modifying event subscriptions to receive different notification types - Reconfiguring we

url.description: The URL to which Sentry will send webhook POST requests when subscribed events occur.

events.description: A list of Sentry event types to subscribe to. Valid event types are: 'event.alert' (triggered when alerts fire) and 'event.created' (triggered when new events are processed).

hook_id.description: The unique identifier (GUID) of the service hook to be updated.

project_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the project to which the service hook belongs.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization to which the service hook belongs.

upload_dsyms_file_to_project.title: Upload dsyms file to project
upload_dsyms_file_to_project.description: Uploads a dSYM (debug symbols) zip archive, containing an Apple .dSYM folder, to the specified Sentry project for symbolicating crash reports from Apple platforms.

file.description: The dSYM file to upload, provided as a zip archive of an Apple .dSYM folder containing debug symbols.

project_id_or_slug.description: Unique ID or slug of the Sentry project.

organization_id_or_slug.description: Unique ID or slug of the Sentry organization.

upload_file_to_project_release.title: Upload file to project release
upload_file_to_project_release.description: Uploads a file to a Sentry project release, for an existing organization, project, and version; uses `multipart/form-data` and the region-specific Sentry domain.

dist.description: Optional: Distribution identifier to distinguish multiple files of the same name within a single release (e.g., for different build variants or AB tests).

name.description: Optional: Name for the file, ideally an absolute path or URI (e.g., for JavaScript source maps, the full web URI to the original '.js' file).

header.description: Optional: Header for the file, formatted as 'Header-Key: Header-Value' (e.g., 'X-SourceMap:/url/to/sourcemap.map' for SourceMap debug images).

version.description: The version identifier of the release to associate the file with.

project_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the Sentry project.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the Sentry organization.

upload_release_file_to_organization.title: Upload release file to organization
upload_release_file_to_organization.description: Uploads a new file, such as a source map or debug information, to an existing release version in a Sentry organization.

dist.description: An optional distribution identifier for the file. This helps differentiate between multiple files with the same name within a single release, often used for build numbers or variant identifiers (e.g., Android versionCode or Xcode build number).

file.description: The file to be uploaded for the release.

name.description: The optional name of the file, which should reflect the absolute path or URI where this file will be referenced. For example, for JavaScript source maps, this could be the full web URI.

header.description: An optional header string or list of strings to be associated with the artifact. This can be used to specify headers like 'Content-Type' or custom metadata. For example: 'Content-Type:application/json' or ['X-SourceMap: /url/to/source.map', 'Content-Type: application/json'].

version.description: The version identifier of the release.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization.

validate_credential.title: Validate credential
validate_credential.description: Validates Sentry API credentials by retrieving the authenticated user's information. Use this action when you need to verify that API credentials are valid and have not expired. This action returns the current user's profile along with authentication token details including scopes and expiration.

view_organization_notification_actions.title: View organization notification actions
view_organization_notification_actions.description: Retrieves Spike Protection notification actions for a Sentry organization, filterable by project IDs or slugs (slugs take precedence); if `triggerType` is used, it must be 'spike-protection'.

project.description: List of project IDs to filter notification actions. Use `[-1]` for all projects. `project_id_or_slug` takes precedence if also provided.

triggerType.description: Filters actions by trigger type. Currently, only 'spike-protection' is supported.

project_id_or_slug.description: List of project slugs to filter notification actions. Use `["$all"]` for all projects. Takes precedence over `project` if also specified.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique ID or slug of the Sentry organization for which to view notification actions.
